review.notes: All 27 complete bilingual entries read. Super-creature neuter agreement, explicit multi-volume encyclopedia set and compact talk objective corrected and reread. Native FishingQuest and DescriptionElement composition inspected: localized item display names are substituted, population reasons nest in the because clause, and all six size fragments follow the same prefix. Greek size fragments supply full genitive articles, replacing the English a/n assembly. Both fisherman/female enthusiast branches retain the native gender block. All species/count objectives, money, keep-fish clause and names retained.
